bitcoin.read: 7 of 22 scored indicators lean bull, 5 bear, 10 neutral: a split, as close to a coin flip as the rules get. Bull: exchange flows, monthly RSI, the cycle clock, the 200-week average, the regression position, fear and greed, the 50/200 cross. Bear: stablecoin supply, section 6 positioning, the dollar, the 50-week average, the support band. Resets still missing: Puell multiple, MVRV, weekly RSI, the Mayer multiple, the drawdown, the one-year return, Pi Cycle. One reset is already in: price tagged the 200-week average at 0.91 on 19 Nov 2026, 5 weeks at or under the line. Clock: 943 days since the halving, 50% below the high of 6 Oct.
